nodes.label: Add a new skill to the lirbox plugin (procedure)
nodes.rationale: Skills are auto-discovered from plugins/lirbox/skills/, so no manifest edit is needed: copy templates/skill-template, make `name` equal the kebab-case directory name, and put bundled resources in scripts/ (executable), references/ (loaded on demand to keep SKILL.md lean), assets/ (used in output, never loaded into context).

nodes.label: Add a new agent to the lirbox plugin (procedure)
nodes.rationale: Agents are auto-discovered from plugins/lirbox/agents/*.md with frontmatter (name, description required; model and tools/permissions.allowedTools optional). Keep agents single-purpose — a tight role plus a clear output contract beats a broad one.

nodes.label: Add a brand-new plugin to the marketplace (procedure)
nodes.rationale: Use a new plugin only when the work is a coherent product of its own rather than another tool in lirbox. Omit `version` during active development so updates track the git SHA — otherwise every release needs a bump or installed users never see changes. The new plugin must also be registered in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json with a name matching its plugin.json.

nodes.label: Marketplace layout rules (do not violate)
nodes.rationale: marketplace.json lives only at repo-root .claude-plugin/; a plugin's .claude-plugin/ holds only plugin.json — skills/, agents/, hooks/ sit at the plugin root, because nested under .claude-plugin/ they silently fail to load (the common mistake). All names kebab-case; runtime references go through ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, never absolute machine paths.

nodes.label: ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} runtime path convention
nodes.rationale: Resolves to the installed plugin dir, so bundled scripts keep working after installation; absolute machine paths would only work on the author's box.

nodes.label: Enforced liemle3893 commit identity (pre-commit hook)
nodes.rationale: A machine's work git config must not leak into public history, so .githooks/pre-commit blocks any commit authored by the work account (liemlhd_msn / crownx / masangroup) or by anything other than the expected personal identity; contributors activate it once via git config core.hooksPath .githooks.

nodes.label: main is pull-request-only (ruleset + pre-push hook)
nodes.rationale: The GitHub ruleset requires a PR, requires both evals jobs green, and forbids force-push/deletion of main; its bypass list is empty so there is no admin escape hatch and loosening it is a visible ruleset edit. Reviews are deliberately not required (0 approvals) because a sole maintainer cannot approve their own PR — CI is the gate, not a rubber-stamp. .githooks/pre-push refuses the same push locally; --no-verify skips the hook but the server still rejects it. Loop run branches (improve/*, opt/*, wf/*, evals/*) stay unrestricted since they already finish by opening a PR.

nodes.label: Validate + smoke-test before pushing
nodes.rationale: `claude plugin validate .` schema-checks the marketplace and all plugins; `claude --plugin-dir ./plugins/lirbox` loads the plugin in a throwaway session so the skill/agent is exercised before it reaches installed users.

nodes.label: description is the single most important skill field
nodes.rationale: The model reads only name + description to decide whether to trigger a skill, so the description must be third-person and explicit about WHEN to use it.
